market_view: VIX 18.7, calm-to-moderate; 10-year yield 4.64% near its high and dollar firm. Oil dropped about 7.5% in one day and the semiconductor ETF and NVDA fell sharply, but the headlines give no cause for either.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI fell 7.5% in a day after a 19% 20-day rally, but no OPEC+, supply or XOM headline explains it. A driver move that already happened is priced in; XOM earnings are inside the window and add variance only.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.5% over 5 days, still 23% below its high, below its 200-day average; yield 4.64% and dollar near highs. No Fed, dollar or NEM headline.

chips.reasoning: NVDA -5% and the sector ETF -2.3% in a day, but headlines are only opinion pieces (Alphabet vs Nvidia, Micron valuation, a data-center gas engine order). An oversold dip is not a catalyst.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific news; only an ETF comparison article that mentions LLY. Small-cap biotech releases are not about the leader. LLY is up 41% in 60 days, near its high.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +0.3% and FCX +6.7% over 5 days with no supply, China or FCX headline. Headlines for this family are unrelated (Ethereum, Berkshire, SpaceX).

would_change_my_mind: A named FCX, XOM, NEM, NVDA or LLY headline (guidance raise, supply shock, export rule, trial or approval result) or an earnings surprise.

handoff.what_changed: Five days since the last note (07-23). WTI fell 7.5% in one day to 82.6 (still +19% over 20 days), NVDA fell 5% and the semiconductor ETF 2.3%, gold rose 1.5% over 5 days, and VIX is 18.7. Headlines again held no leader-specific catalyst.

oil_gas.why: One-day oil drop has no named cause and no XOM or OPEC+ headline.

gold_miners.why: Gold bounce lacks a Fed, dollar or NEM catalyst.

chips.why: NVDA and sector sell-off has no explaining headline, only opinion pieces.

pharma.why: No LLY news in the headlines.

copper_uranium.why: FCX rise has no supply or demand headline.
